x: In a recent article in the Sunday Express, the writer expressed confidence that Britain's young athletes will soon be amongst the world's best. Amongst those mentioned, we were favoured by the mention of seven members:—Broadbent, Clay, Frost, Brown, Marchant, Burfitt and Main.
We were unable to see much of Stan this summer and we hope that next summer we shall see him in action against Clay and Frost. Len Marchant has been running well in R.A.F. teams.

McKeown was second in the Youths' 880 yards, won in 2 mins. 6.2 secs. Clay and Frost qualified for the final of the sprint but were unplaced.

The chief feature of the race was the forward running of several of the younger school, particularly Stan Eeles who perhaps ran his best race to date—Stan has the makings of a real runner if he will get down to it, Fred Clay, John Brown, Bob Boyden, Norman Walker and Alf Heathfield.
